editorial:
If you love fast, brutal action movies with a strong female lead, this one is going to grab you right away. The story follows a young assassin who was trained to kill without question, but everything changes when she meets a boy caught up in a ruthless crime syndicate. Instead of walking away, she decides to protect him, even if it means turning against her own mentor and fighting an entire criminal empire. The vibe is dark, intense, and packed with nonstop fights that feel raw and real. You can tell the director wanted every punch and gunshot to hit hard, and it shows on screen.

The action scenes are the real star here, with long, bloody fight sequences that will keep you on the edge of your seat. The lead actress does a great job showing both toughness and heart, making you care about her journey. On the downside, the story can feel a little thin at times, and the violence is very graphic, so it is not for everyone. If you enjoy movies like The Raid or John Wick, you will probably have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the young assassin finally confronts her mentor in a brutal showdown after cutting through the crime syndicate's top fighters. She manages to save the boy and get him to safety, but not before suffering serious injuries herself. The twist comes when you learn her mentor was secretly working with the syndicate all along, using her as a weapon for their dirty work. In the end, she walks away from her old life, leaving her mentor behind, and starts fresh with the boy as her new purpose.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-octane action movies with strong female leads and gritty fight scenes.
